stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsa ad proposita dubia, coetus plenarius 14 Maii 1985 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Negative. He does not vote with them.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Where the law requires a superior to have the consent of a college or group of persons, whether the superior himself has the right to vote with the others, at least to break a tie.
